mario kart.ecvDetailNote: Lower Lot is reached via StarWay escalators or accessible shuttle vans. Transfer from ECV to a manual wheelchair for the queue.
mario kart.description: Put on augmented-reality goggles inside Bowser's Castle to steer, throw shells, and race Team Bowser across iconic Mario Kart courses.

jurassic world.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a manual wheelchair for the queue, then step down into the raft. Expect a soaking 84-foot plunge.
jurassic world.description: Drift past the Mosasaurus aquarium before an Indominus rex breakout sends your raft plunging down an 84-foot waterfall.

studio tour.ecvDetailNote: Dedicated accessible tram cars feature a ramp so guests can remain in their manual wheelchair or ECV for the entire 60-minute tour.
studio tour.description: Explore a real working Hollywood movie studio backlot featuring King Kong 360 3-D, Jaws, Earthquake, and Fast & Furious – Supercharged.

forbidden journey.ecvDetailNote: Transfer to a manual wheelchair at the castle entrance. Ask Team Members for the stationary load platform to bypass the moving walkway.
forbidden journey.description: Soar above Hogwarts grounds, dodge a dragon, and face Dementors on an enchanted bench inside Hogwarts Castle.

revenge of the mummy.ecvDetailNote: All loose bags must go into free lockers near the entrance. Standard coaster transfer at the load station.
revenge of the mummy.description: Plunge into pitch-black Egyptian tombs at 45 mph with forwards and backwards coaster launches.

transformers.ecvDetailNote: Transfer from ECV to a manual wheelchair at the entrance; elevator provides access to the upper load level.
transformers.description: Join Optimus Prime and Bumblebee inside EVAC to protect the AllSpark from Megatron in a fast-paced 3D battle.

secret life of pets.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair; Cast Members can slow or stop the load belt for easier boarding.
secret life of pets.description: Transform into a stray puppy and journey through New York City with Max, Duke, and Snowball on your way to Adoption Day.

simpsons ride.ecvDetailNote: Elevator access to simulator rooms; guests must transfer from wheelchair into the ride car.
simpsons ride.description: Join Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, and Maggie on a chaotic virtual coaster through Krustyland.

minion mayhem.ecvDetailNote: Stationary accessible seating is available at the front of the theater so guests can remain in their wheelchair without transferring.
minion mayhem.description: Enter Gru's laboratory for chaotic Minion training in a family-friendly motion simulator.

flight of the hippogriff.ecvDetailNote: ECVs transfer to a manual wheelchair for the queue; standard step-over transfer into the coaster car.
flight of the hippogriff.description: Swoop past Hagrid's Hut and a bowing Hippogriff on a gentle outdoor family coaster.

waterworld.description: Action-packed live water stunt spectacular featuring jet skis, fireballs, explosions, and a crashing seaplane.

frog choir.description: Hogwarts students from all four houses perform a cappella wizarding songs accompanied by giant bass-croaking frogs.

triwizard spirit.description: Colorful procession and martial arts/rhythmic gymnastics display by Beauxbatons and Durmstrang students.

ollivanders.description: Intimate interactive wandkeeper ceremony where a wand chooses a wizard from the audience.
